tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently joined a new yoga class at your local community center. The instructor, Mr. Davis, has been very welcoming and helpful. However, you find the class schedule inconvenient and would prefer if the classes were held at a different time that fits better with your daily routine. Write an email to Mr. Davis.
bullets: Thank him for his support and guidance in the yoga class.
Explain why the current class schedule is inconvenient for you.
Suggest alternative times that would work better for you and possibly other participants.
tasks.subject: Yoga Class Schedule Change
